g: diminutive of malleus: A small hammer or mallet.

diminutive of malleus: A mallet-shoot or hammer-shaped slip or cutting; literally, a “little hammer.” A propagation method where a young, green shoot is harvested with a small, horizontal section of the older, woody branch still attached at the base. This “T” junction resembles a mallet — the older wood forms the “head” and the new shoot forms the “handle” — providing a sturdy, nutrient-rich base for new roots to develop.
diminutive of malleus: A kind of fire-dart.
diminutive of malleus: The tongue of a shoe buckle.
